sources.title: The Virtual World That Teaches Robots - blog.pebblous.ai
sources.snippet: If GPT is the foundation model for language AI, GR00T is the foundation model for humanoid robots. NVIDIA unveiled GR00T N1 at GTC 2025 in March. GR00T stands for Generalist Robot 00 Technology — pronounced "Groot," like the Marvel character. The goal: a single model that adapts to diverse humanoid bodies and tasks. GR00T N1 model overview.
